second_order: making and showing the Little Busters cat together
theme_note: All four passages carry one shared practice across stages: supplying a guide and location for the cat, keeping further additions conditional on completing it, then announcing and showing completion. What varies is the work each passage performs: orienting, planning, and celebrating with evidence.
regrouped_from: Grouping review: kept the four codes together after testing whether guiding, conditional planning, and completion were separate practices; here they are successive parts of the same named cat project.
